name: Johnston Recreation Summer Day Camp
activities: water play (sprinklers, splash pad, inflatable waterslide)
description_short: Johnston Recreation Department's six-week summer day camp at Johnston Memorial Park for ages 6 to 12, Monday to Friday 8:30am to 4:30pm, with group games, sports, arts and crafts, playground time and afternoon water play, plus optional field trips 2 to 3 times a week at extra cost. Families can sign up for the whole summer, single weeks or single days.
refund_policy_summary: $100 per family due at registration to hold a spot; balance due by July 1. Once camp begins, no refunds without a doctor's note (prorated). Field trips cost extra and are non-refundable without a doctor's note.
swim_waterfront_notes: No swimming listed; most afternoons have water play (sprinklers, splash pad, inflatable waterslide).

sessions.name: Summer Day Camp (6 weeks; no camp Aug 10)
